clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Group comparisons of ROI deviation counts (ASD vs controls) showed no differences; within ASD, no significant associations between cerebellar structure/deviations and ADOS-2, SRS-2, RRB, ADHD diagnosis, age, sex, or FSIQ (multiple heterogeneity-focused analyses, matched sample analyses, and site-wise meta-analyses also null).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Across CERES/SUIT parcellations, VBM, and voxelwise GPR-based normative modeling, there were no case-control differences or significant individual-level cerebellar deviations in autism, nor associations with clinical measures.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: In LEAP (ASD n=274; controls n=219; 3T T1w MRI across 6 sites), ROI parcellations (CERES, SUIT) and SUIT-VBM found no diagnosis effects after covarying age, sex, ICV, FSIQ, and site. Voxelwise GPR normative modeling (covariates: age, sex, site, FSIQ, ICV) with 10-fold CV in controls showed good fit (Rho positive; SMSE < 1) but no increased/decreased deviations at cerebellum or lobular levels (removing FSIQ unchanged). Site-wise analyses with meta-analysis found only uncorrected, non-robust effects; balanced accuracies ≤52% for predictive classification.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: 3T T1w volumetry may be insensitive to fine-grained cerebellar microstructure; SUIT isolation defects required masking; potential heterogeneity in ASD may obscure subtle subgroups; reliance on structural MRI only.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Robust preprocessing with dual parcellations (CERES, SUIT) and SUIT-VBM; stringent QC including expert visual inspection and SUIT isolation correction; site modeled as covariate and evaluated via meta-analysis; matched-sample sensitivity analyses performed.

general_notes.general_notes: Scanning sites and vendors: Cambridge (Siemens Verio), London (GE Discovery MR750), Mannheim (Siemens TimTrio), Nijmegen (Siemens Skyra), Rome (GE Signa HDxt), Utrecht (Philips Achieva/Ingenia CX). Acquisition: 1.2 mm T1w. SUIT isolation defects mitigated using CERES-based mask. No ComBat; site handled via covariate and meta-analysis.
